title: Nimble
summary: NIM'BLE, adjective Light and quick in motion; moving with ease and celerity; lively; swift. It is applied chiefly to motions of the feet and hands, sometimes to other things; as a nimble boy; the nimb

inlines.v: NIM'BLE, adjective Light and quick in motion; moving with ease and celerity; lively; swift. It is applied chiefly to motions of the feet and hands, sometimes to other things; as a nimble boy; the nimble-footed deer. Through the mid seas the nimble pinnace sails.
